name: Gathered Fetters
description: Gather a fetter on every soul in reach and read them all through the one grip.

name: Hooked Gyve
description: Set a hooked gyve in one soul that holds it where it stands.

name: Gyve Bulwark
description: Chain gyves into a bulwark before the student that bears a steady press of soul force.

name: Barbed Cinch
description: Cinch a barbed fetter on a soul so that the barbs bite as it closes.

name: Ruinous Shackle
description: Close a shackle that grips so hard the soul cannot move or gather force.

name: Fetter Torrent
description: Pour a torrent of fetters over the opposing line so that each soul is cinched and thrown.

name: Chained Aegis
description: Bind a rampart of held souls about the student that no soul-strike can cross.

name: Dragging Chain
description: Drag a bound soul across the field by the chain and cast it down before the student.

name: Ruinous Immurement
description: Wall in a whole line of souls with fetters so that no technique can leave them.

name: Crushing Yoke
description: Lower a yoke on the held souls that presses their force to nothing.

name: Fetter Absorption
description: Draw the soul force of every blow into the fetters and let them grow heavier by it.

name: Ruin Chain
description: Cast the school's great chain over the field so that every soul in it is held and every guard is drawn tight.

name: Closing Ruin
description: Draw every fetter shut at once so that the whole field is bound and pressed down to the ruinous ceiling of a Xiantian soul and nothing weaker can rise.
